title: Muse research findings intake
description: Schema for research findings contributed by Muse (a meta agent app) via the GitHub API. Findings are research input, never trusted desk output: they become candidates or Yellow Sheets only after independent review. No fabricated numbers, no probability/RoR claims on delayed data, no trade authorization, no secrets/PII.

session.description: Market session the findings were produced for, e.g. 2026-09-25 (close).

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the session.

symbol.description: Uppercase ticker. Use 'MARKET' for market-wide, 'PRODUCT' for Emporion product-level.

sources.description: Every claim must cite a public https source. No fabricated numbers.

risk_flags.description: Concrete risks, e.g. 'earnings 2026-10-16 falls inside 33-DTE window'.

invalidation_threshold.description: The condition under which this finding stops being relevant.
